treatment seed-mean B >= 0.15; by CALIBRATION this needs a downstream-uniform eps of mean about 0.05 (eps 0.025 -> B 0.076, 0.05 -> 0.153, 0.1 -> 0.301)

treatment B above its own twin B in >= 9 of 10 seeds
